# Release checklist

## Before release

- [ ] tests pass
- [ ] smoke evaluation passes
- [ ] README is updated
- [ ] security guidance reviewed
- [ ] changelog written
- [ ] sample fixtures still reflect the current skill set

## Release notes

- Summary of new skills or capability updates
- Known limitations
- Breaking changes
- Migration notes (if any)

## Post-release

- check GitHub Actions status
- verify public repo still renders correctly
- note issues for the next iteration
